# bearmq_queue (Data Source)

Look up a queue by name within a virtual host.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "bearmq_vhost" "orders" {
  name = "orders-prod"
}

data "bearmq_queue" "paid" {
  vhost_id = data.bearmq_vhost.orders.id
  name     = "orders.paid"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Queue name.
- `vhost_id` (String) Owning virtual host ID.

### Read-Only

- `actual_name` (String) Internal storage name.
- `auto_delete` (Boolean) Whether the queue is deleted after its last consumer disconnects.
- `durable` (Boolean) Whether the queue survives a broker restart.
- `exclusive` (Boolean) Whether the queue is bound to a single connection.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned queue ID.
- `max_message_count` (Number) Configured maximum message count.
- `overflow_policy` (String) Overflow policy.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status.
